metadata.description: Curated marketplace for Fernando Furtado's meta-bridge plugin — Claude Code ↔ Logseq cognitive hub.

plugins.name: meta-bridge
plugins.description: Bridge skills + hook materializing Camada 3 between Claude Code sessions and a Logseq cognitive graph. /journal-note for cross-domain capture in hashtag-buckets; /journal-close for session synthesis as DONE tasks grouped by repo; /journal-load for read-only loading of journal content into CC working memory; /init-logseq-project for repo→Project Page sync; /journal-review for detective-first review of configurable journal window via 4 structural heuristics + opt-in GTD wizard (successor to /weekly-review); suggest_journal_close hook reacting to pragmatic-dev-toolkit's /run-plan completion marker.
